paths.description: Homepage and primary video listing template; tested at desktop/mobile, dark, forced-colors, reduced-motion, keyboard-focus, no-JS, performance, security, network and memory conditions.
Latest-updates listing archetype, representing paginated/recent video listings.
Primary search journey with a zero-results state.
Video-detail archetype and primary playback action, using the first homepage video.
Invalid video and arbitrary missing-route recovery state; verified the custom 404 page and HTTP status.

findings.summary: The dark palette is hard-coded rather than tied to the user’s color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot is identical to the default mobile screenshot; the CSS probe reports colorScheme="normal" and no prefers-color-scheme, light-dark(), or color-scheme signal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare supported schemes early with a color-scheme meta/property and derive surfaces from prefers-color-scheme or light-dark(), including an intentional light palette.

findings.summary: Navigation swaps pages abruptly and does not use cross-document View Transitions.
findings.evidence: CSS inspection across the homepage styles found no view-transition rules; navigation is a conventional MPA with no transition treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Add @view-transition { navigation: auto } and stable view-transition-name values for shared header/content elements, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Reusable cards adapt only through global responsive CSS, not their containing space.
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no @container or container-type declarations although the same card/list components appear in main and sidebar contexts.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable list/card wrappers an appropriate container-type and move component layout changes into @container queries.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is not visibly indicated across primary navigation and search controls.
findings.evidence: A scripted focus walk over the first 20 controls reported outline styles such as “none 3px” and boxShadow="none" for every sampled link, input, and button.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a high-contrast :focus-visible treatment with sufficient offset for links, buttons, the search field, menu items, and player controls; verify the full Tab sequence.

findings.summary: Activating the primary Play control causes an unsolicited navigation/target replacement before playback can be verified.
findings.evidence: The CDP playback attempt clicked .fp-play and then failed with “Inspected target navigated or closed”; the network evidence includes a.pemsrv.com/popunder1000.js and s.pemsrv.com/venor.php.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the popunder/navigation handler from playback. Keep the current tab on the video, start media only from the explicit user gesture, and test play/pause/fullscreen end-to-end.

findings.summary: Render-blocking resources and short cache lifetimes add avoidable work to an otherwise fast page.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 370 ms render-blocking savings and 79 KiB cache-lifetime savings; the HAR confirms parser-inserted high-priority CSS and a classic main.min.js without async/defer/module.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline only critical CSS, defer non-critical styles, make non-critical JavaScript deferred/module-based, and use long immutable caching for versioned static assets.

findings.summary: The page ships avoidable unused and legacy code.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports about 41 KiB unused JavaScript, 16 KiB unused CSS, 4 KiB unminified CSS, and 9 KiB legacy JavaScript.
findings.suggestedFix: Use coverage to split route-specific CSS/JS, remove dead rules and polyfills, minify CSS, and serve a modern bundle to Baseline browsers.

findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports an unnamed navigation button and no main landmark; the DOM probe independently found one unnamed button, seven empty links, and zero main/[role=main] elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Give the menu/search icon controls explicit accessible names, ensure icon links have names, and wrap the unique page content in <main>.

findings.summary: Muted counts and video metadata do not meet minimum text contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured a 1.99:1 ratio for #3f3f3f text on #000000, below the required 4.5:1 for the 12–14 px metadata.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise muted text colors to at least 4.5:1 against black and re-test all card metadata, durations, ratings, and footer text.

findings.summary: The viewport declaration prevents mobile users from zooming.
findings.evidence: The live viewport meta is width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=0; Lighthouse fails the user-scaling audit.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale and user-scalable restrictions so browser zoom remains available, then verify 200% and 400% reflow.

findings.summary: Listing thumbnails are neither responsive nor consistently sharp at their rendered size.
findings.evidence: All 24 audited images lack srcset; nine loaded images are JPEG, and Lighthouse flags 336×189 thumbnails rendered at 392×221 with a 588×332 density-adjusted target.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP responsive variants, publish width descriptors in srcset with accurate sizes, and choose a source large enough for device pixel ratio.

findings.summary: The document cannot use the back/forward cache.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports CacheControlNoStoreHTTPOnlyCookieModified as the actionable BFCache blocker.
findings.suggestedFix: Avoid modifying a session cookie on anonymous read-only pages and replace blanket no-store with cache directives appropriate to public content.

findings.summary: At least one footer destination is JavaScript-only rather than a crawlable link.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse identifies the Support control as <a data-href="…/feedback/" data-fancybox="ajax"> without href; the DOM probe also found seven empty links.
findings.suggestedFix: Use real href destinations for all navigation, enhancing them with dialog behavior only after the baseline link works.

findings.summary: Transport and browser defenses are incomplete, and session-related cookies are not hardened.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence shows no CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy. Cookies evidence shows PHPSESSID and kt_tcookie without Secure, and PHPSESSID without HttpOnly.
findings.suggestedFix: Add HSTS, a nonce/hash-based CSP, nosniff, strict referrer/permissions policies, and frame-ancestors; mark session cookies Secure, HttpOnly, and appropriate SameSite.

findings.summary: Advertising/analytics code runs by default and includes a popunder vendor.
findings.evidence: The HAR records 39,515 third-party bytes, including a.pemsrv.com/popunder1000.js; the runtime also loads Cloudflare Zaraz and s.pemsrv.com/venor.php, while no consent surface was observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove popunder code, minimise analytics, defer non-essential third parties until informed consent where required, and document each vendor’s purpose and retention.

findings.summary: Arabic pages declare English and omit RTL direction, while CSS is dominated by physical properties.
findings.evidence: Every sampled route has <html lang="en"> with no dir despite Arabic content. The stylesheet probe found only 3 logical-property matches versus 178 physical left/right properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Set lang="ar" and dir="rtl" at the document root, use dir="ltr" only for isolated Latin content, and migrate layout to logical block/inline properties.

taskList.title: Remove popunder behavior and make video playback stay in the current tab
Restore keyboard and assistive-technology access: names, landmarks, focus, contrast and zoom
Remove or consent-gate non-essential advertising and analytics
Declare Arabic/RTL correctly and migrate layout to logical properties
Reduce render blocking, unused code and anonymous-page BFCache blockers
Make every navigation destination a real named link
Adopt View Transitions and container queries progressively
